case_name: Matseti Santhoshi Gude Santhoshi v. Gude Lahari Krishna

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Petitioner (wife) seeking maintenance and interim stay

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Wife seeks maintenance, interim stay due to matrimonial disputes, harassment, and pending cases.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to nullify a marriage to prove its invalidity.
legal_principles.held: He would further contend that to cause unnecessary inconvenience to the petitioner, the respondent/husband had filed F.C.O.P.No.335 of 2025, on the file of the Additional Family Judge Court, Visakhapatnam, under Section 12(1)(c) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, to declare the marriage of the petitioner with the respondent as null and void.

legal_principles.principle: The distance between two places is a relevant factor in determining the feasibility of attending court proceedings.
legal_principles.held: He would further contend that the distance between Rajahmundry and Visakhapatnam, is more than 200 Kms, it is very difficult for the petitioner/wife to attend the divorce case proceedings before the Additional Family Judge Court, Visakhapatnam, on each and every day.
cited_cases: Matseti Santhoshi Gude Santhoshi, vs Gude Lahari Krishna, (2025)

outcome.final_order: Interim Stay of all further proceedings including the appearance of the petitioner herein i.e., the respondent in F.C.O.P.No.335 of 2025.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
